title: basalt plugin enable --approval-id --json: the wait for a plugin to run
description: What basalt plugin enable --approval-id ID[,ID] --json prints once its wait ends, and what basalt plugin add or enable --wait N --json prints when the plugin runs before the wait ends. The command opens and writes nothing. Exit 0 for RUNNING and WAITING, 1 for NOT_RUNNING and ENDED. The agent shows personMessage to the person verbatim and follows nextSteps. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Plugin approval commands.

state.description: RUNNING: every approval is signed, and the running engine serves the entry, READY, to each listed agent an approval names, on that approval. WAITING: an approval is still pending when the wait ends. NOT_RUNNING: every approval is signed, and the engine is not running or does not serve the entry yet when the wait ends. ENDED: an approval is no longer open (it expired, a newer one replaced it, it ended, or no listed agent's database shows it for this entry).

approvals.description: One item per --approval-id, in the order given.

state.description: As basalt plugin list says it; CANCELLED: a newer approval for the entry replaced it; NONE: no listed agent's database shows it for this entry.

agents.description: The entry's agents, by their names in engine.json, that the approval names and whose database answered.
